resclamp <0-4>

Caps the size a scene is drawn at, as a multiple of your largest screen.
Lower saves video memory. It never enlarges anything, and turning it off
can remove blur this cap caused. Decimals work; 0 or below means no cap.

Default 1. Takes effect at the next service restart, or at the next show
for one wallpaper. effectclamp is the same cap for glow, blur and other
effect layers, set on its own.

One wallpaper:  wallpaper <wallpaper> resclamp 0

Examples:
  resclamp 0          no cap: draw at the artwork's full size
  resclamp 1.5        up to one and a half screens
  resclamp load       back to what your files say
  get resclamp        print the current value

Also found by: resolution, sharpness, blur, video memory.
